faq:
Frequently Asked Questions

What does modern interior design mean for a Hauz Khas home?

It means open, uncluttered rooms with clean lines, neutral colours and practical furniture. In compact South Delhi floors, this approach makes rooms feel larger and brighter.

Can modern design feel warm and not cold?

Yes. Wood, textured fabrics, warm lighting and plants soften a modern space, so it feels welcoming as well as stylish.

Is modern design suitable for cafés and studios?

Yes. Many cafés, studios and boutiques in Hauz Khas use a modern style because it lets the product, art or food take centre stage.

How is modern interior design different from minimalism?

Minimalism keeps only the essentials. A modern style is also clean and simple, but it allows more materials, colour and personal pieces.
